## Instructions

You can run the code in individual chunks in an RMarkdown document (instead of all at once) by hitting the 'play' button on a chunk. I would recommend doing it this way so you can walk through step-by-step.
  
First: open the csv on the OneDrive and enter your trend values. Upload it to RStudio Cloud. Then run the following:

```{r}
trend_data <- read.csv("trend_data.csv")

```

Now you can examine your data and make sure it loaded correctly.

## T Test

If you are doing a comparison of two groups (two species, two regions, etc), use this code

### First, visualize your data:

```{r}
trend_data |> ggplot(aes(x="group1", y="group2")) +
  geom_boxplot()
```

### Next, check the t-test assumptions:

Normality

```{r}
trend_data |> select(group1) |> shapiro.test()
trend_data |> select(group2) |> shapiro.test()
```

Equal variance

```{r}

var.test(trend_data$group1, trend_data$group2)
```

### Run the t-test & print the results

If variance is NOT equal, set var.equal to FALSE
If doing a 1-tailed test, add alternative="greater" or alternative="less"

```{r}
out <- t.test(trend_data$group1, trend_data$group2, var.equal=TRUE)

out
```
